preview.readOnly: Browser preview is read-only. Configure models in the macOS app.
preview.mcpReadOnly: Browser preview only; configure MCP in the macOS app.

status.partialModelReadFailed: Some model statuses could not be read. Recording and keyword search are still available.

capability.voiceLocalDescription: Chinese, English, and more · about 1.02 GB
capability.voiceModelPlaceholder: For example, whisper-1 or a provider model ID
capability.savedKeyPlaceholder: Saved; leave empty to keep it
capability.emptyKeyPlaceholder: Can be empty for a local service
capability.localPrivacy: Your content is processed on this Mac. It is not sent to an AI service.
capability.embeddingPrivacy: The selected service receives memory text and search queries. Search data is stored on this Mac.
capability.voicePrivacy: Audio is sent to the selected service as you record. You can edit the transcript; it is saved only when you submit it.
capability.llmPrivacy: The selected service receives your messages and relevant memories to respond and update memories. Automatic note organization also sends new notes and relevant context.
capability.autoOrganizeDescription: Organize new notes after saving. Turning this off does not stop memory updates during chats. Notes saved while off will not be organized automatically when you turn it back on.
capability.assistantDescription: Discuss ideas, recall memories, and keep them up to date.
capability.embeddingPrivacyDetails: This includes existing memories during setup, later additions and edits, and queries used to find related memories or search through MCP. Original captures, version history, trash, and drafts are excluded.
capability.reasoningDescription: May shorten the wait for replies. Only applies to models that support this setting.

embedding.failedMemories_one: {{count}} memory could not be processed. You can still find it by keyword.
embedding.failedMemories_other: {{count}} memories could not be processed. You can still find them by keyword.
embedding.confirmCurrent: This will process the current memories. You can still record, read, and use keyword search while preparation runs.
embedding.confirmCount_one: This will process {{count}} current memory. You can still record, read, and use keyword search while preparation runs.
embedding.confirmCount_other: This will process {{count}} current memories. You can still record, read, and use keyword search while preparation runs.
embedding.localConfirm: Everything is processed on this Mac. Archived items, history, trash, and drafts are excluded.
embedding.remoteConfirm: Text excerpts will be sent to “{{service}}”; later additions and edits are processed incrementally and may incur provider charges. Archived items, history, trash, and drafts are excluded.
embedding.rebuildCurrent: The current memories will be processed again with the active model. A model service receives text excerpts and may charge for them; a local model processes them on this Mac. Keyword search remains available and the text stays unchanged.
embedding.rebuildCount_one: The active model will process {{count}} current memory again. A model service receives text excerpts and may charge for them; a local model processes them on this Mac. Keyword search remains available and the text stays unchanged.
embedding.rebuildCount_other: The active model will process {{count}} current memories again. A model service receives text excerpts and may charge for them; a local model processes them on this Mac. Keyword search remains available and the text stays unchanged.

voice.preloadDescription: When off, the model loads when you start recording. Memory is freed after one minute of inactivity.
voice.shortcutDescription: Press once to open the quick entry and record; press again to stop.
voice.unloadDescription: Unloading frees RAM and keeps the downloaded files. The model loads again when you record.

desktop.title: Quick entry
desktop.shortcutDescription: The global shortcut opens or collapses Quick Entry, even after closing the main window. ⌘Q quits Memivy.
desktop.foregroundPrivacy: The foreground app name is read when you open Quick Entry. Links and file paths are only attached by you.

login.title: Start at login
login.notFoundHelp: Move Memivy to the Applications folder and try again.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: Backups include memories, original captures, versions, discussions, drafts, and trash; model keys are excluded.
backup.restoreDescription: Restore the entire library and automatically keep a copy from before the restore.
backup.verifiedSummary: This backup contains {{memories}} memories and {{captures}} original captures. Memivy will restart and replace the current library with this backup. A copy of the current library will be saved first.
backup.settingsRetained: Model configuration and the MCP switch keep their current settings.

storage.title: Downloaded models
storage.description: Delete downloaded models to free up space. Your memories are kept; you can download the models again when needed.
storage.deleteDialogDescription: This will free about {{size}} MB. You will need to download this model again to use it.
storage.localModelDisabled: Features using this model will be turned off.
storage.serviceUnaffected: Features using an API are not affected.
storage.contentRetained: Memories, original captures, and drafts are kept.

mcp.title: Connect other AI apps
mcp.description: Use MCP to let other AI apps search your saved memories and save text you ask them to remember.
mcp.allowAccess: Allow other AI apps to save and search memories
mcp.enabledNotice: Enabled. Copy the setup prompt below and send it to your agent.
mcp.disabledNotice: Disabled. Other AI apps can no longer save or search memories through MCP.
mcp.executableMissing: The external connection component is missing. Reinstall Memivy.
mcp.setupInstructions: Turn on access above, then copy the prompt below and send it to the agent you want to connect. Ask it to configure Memivy and check the connection. The agent needs permission to edit its MCP settings.
mcp.setupPromptCopied: Copied. Send the prompt to your agent to set up Memivy.
mcp.connectionInstructions: Move Memivy to Applications, then copy the configuration into your other AI app. The app must support local MCP servers (stdio). Reconnect after saving the configuration. If you move Memivy later, copy the configuration again.
mcp.afterExit: Other AI apps can still save and search memories when Memivy is closed. Automatic note organization resumes when you reopen Memivy with a model available. Turn off access here to stop new requests.
mcp.diagnosticPassed_one: MCP check passed. {{count}} function is available.
mcp.diagnosticPassed_other: MCP check passed. {{count}} functions are available.
mcp.diagnosticScope: Memivy is ready to connect. Try saving and searching from your other AI app to check its connection.
mcp.diagnosticEnabled: Read and write access is currently allowed.
mcp.diagnosticDisabled: Access is turned off. Saving and searching memories are unavailable.
mcp.tryConnection: In your other AI app, ask it to remember a test note, then ask it to find that note.
mcp.privacyDescription: Other AI apps may send the returned memories to their own model services. If semantic search uses an API, search queries are also sent to that service.

searchMaintenance.title: Search maintenance
searchMaintenance.rebuildDescription: Try rebuilding search data if saved memories are missing from results.
searchMaintenance.dialogDescription: Search data will be rebuilt. Your memories and drafts will not be changed.

updates.title: App updates
updates.disabled: Updates are available in the installed release app.
